title: Oyatie shared IaC module library — canonical primitive enumeration
description: Canonical machine-readable enumeration of the shared OpenTofu IaC module-library primitives Oyatie ships at microservices/cloud-iac/modules/<context>/<primitive>/. Authored as the spec-side artifact of ADR-0339 D-8 (catalog + discoverability contract). The companion human-readable catalog lives at docs/standards/iac-module-catalog.md per ADR-0339 B2.014/B2.029. The five canonical deployment contexts are aws-guest + oci-guest + on-prem + colo + oyatie-as-cloud-provider, with the sub-context oci-guest/always-free reserved for demo_trial-tenant-only primitives within the OCI Always Free perpetual ceiling per `feedback_oci_always_free_maximization_2026_05_20`. The library starts with ~50 canonical primitives enumerated in ADR-0339 D-4 (10 aws-guest + 8 oci-guest + 6 oci-guest/always-free + 7 on-prem + 7 colo + ~12 oyatie-as-cloud-provider). This file is a STUB at landing per ADR-0339 A.8.1; module-body authoring is sequenced as Wave 15Q-IaC-modules under ADR-0328 batch discipline. Per-primitive entries are filled in by Wave 15Q-IaC-modules with full input/output contract + cosign attestation digest + per-pack compliance attestation references. The catalog.json mirror lives at microservices/cloud-iac/modules/catalog.json per ADR-0339 B2.029.

context_descriptions.aws-guest: AWS-hosted with Oyatie as the SaaS operator per ADR-0215.
context_descriptions.oci-guest: OCI-hosted with Oyatie as the SaaS operator per ADR-0215; paid tenants land in this context.
context_descriptions.oci-guest/always-free: OCI Always Free perpetual-ceiling sub-context for demo_trial tenants per `feedback_oci_always_free_maximization_2026_05_20` + ADR-0331 §D-8.4; modules MUST validate tenant_class == "demo_trial".
context_descriptions.on-prem: Customer-controlled bare-metal or VM cluster per ADR-0215.
context_descriptions.colo: Colocated customer cluster (alias of on-prem topology) per ADR-0339 B2.022; primitives are symlinks-via-source-pin to on-prem unless colo-specific divergence exists.
context_descriptions.oyatie-as-cloud-provider: Oyatie running its own cellular topology per ADR-0248 (collapsed from prior ADR-0331 §D-8 oyatie-public-cloud + oyatie-cloud-provider per ADR-0339 B2.004).

per_primitive_required_fields_when_wave_.name: kebab-case primitive identifier scoped to context
per_primitive_required_fields_when_wave_.cosign_attestation_digest: sha256 cosign attestation digest per ADR-0181 + ADR-0339 B2.025
per_primitive_required_fields_when_wave_.input_contract: object describing OpenTofu variables (name, type, required, default, validation)
per_primitive_required_fields_when_wave_.output_contract: object describing OpenTofu outputs (name, type, description)
per_primitive_required_fields_when_wave_.providers_required: array of OpenTofu provider source + version constraints

primitive_addition_protocol.step_1: Author IP at microservices/cloud-iac/IPs/IP-iac-module-<context>-<primitive>.md per ADR-0322 substance-bar
primitive_addition_protocol.step_2: Author module body at microservices/cloud-iac/modules/<context>/<primitive>/ with main.tf + variables.tf + outputs.tf + versions.tf + README.md + compliance/ subdirectory per ADR-0339 D-1.4
primitive_addition_protocol.step_3: Add catalog entry to docs/standards/iac-module-catalog.md per ADR-0339 D-8
primitive_addition_protocol.step_4: Add primitive entry to this file's primitives[<context>] array
primitive_addition_protocol.step_5: Add primitive entry to microservices/cloud-iac/modules/catalog.json machine-readable mirror per ADR-0339 B2.029
primitive_addition_protocol.step_7: Lane sweep: oya-check-iac-module-catalog-discoverability + oya-check-iac-module-signature-cosign + oya-check-iac-opentofu-only must all pass before merge

wave_15Q_iac_modules_dispatch_note: The ~50 module bodies enumerated above are queued for Wave 15Q-IaC-modules under ADR-0328 batch discipline per ADR-0339 B2.019. Wave 15Q-IaC-modules dispatch sequencing lives in /specs/master-plan-sequencing.json#realignment_wave_sequence.waves_15_plus.sub_waves. Per-µservice migration of existing iac/<context>/main.tf bodies to thin-wrapper invocations follows per-µservice IPs at microservices/<name>/IPs/IP-iac-module-library-migration.md per ADR-0339 B2.017.
